renderings.value: The emotion they gave me was exquisite, but I could not preserve it, nor could I indefinitely repeat it; the most beautiful things in the world finished by boring me.
He still holds the heavyweight title.
The human heart has hidden treasures, in secret kept, in silence sealed.
